latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly generate and export captioned videos for creators.

- Upload video files (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM) and generate captions in multiple languages using a cloud AI backend.
- No installation or manual editing required; just describe the desired output and retrieve a 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- Automatic setup with free, time-limited credits for new users.
- Clear workflow support: upload, caption, download, and check credits/status, all via simple prompts.
- Supports multiple input formats, batch processing, and iterative editing within the same session.
